Independent exhaustive backtracking across every legal map to C5 gives precisely 3300 maps. Reconstructing all legal single-vertex recolorings gives 11340 undirected edges; all-source BFS verifies connectedness and diameter/radius35. The constant-on-each-bipartition representative 0/1 has every oriented incidence edge from points to lines, so is acyclic. Apply the inspected published Fujii–Iwamasa–Kimura–Nozaki–Suzuki Theorem5.1 to the unique connected component: homotopy equivalent to S1. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for the fixed graph; the general Hom-complex theorem is external and not proved anew.

originality.rationale: PASS best-of-knowledge: Fujii et al cycle-target Hom-complex Theorem5.1 supplies conditional homotopy classification of an individually specified component only, and not the global connectivity or number of Heawood C5 colorings or recoloring diameter. Wrochna homomorphism reconfiguration algorithm for square-free target supplies decidability, not values for this canonical graph pair. Cukic–Kozlov cycle-to-cycle source family excludes Heawood. Full primary relevant theorem and definitions were read; semantic published corpus and aliases yielded no prior 3300/11340/35 exact benchmark. Unindexed finite enumeration remains priority risk.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed C5 recoloring census for Heawood might reproduce the 3300/11340/35 invariant.
The homotopy component criterion itself is published; only global instance counts/connectedness are independently claimed.
